home.tagline: Copy once, paste on every device you own.
home.noteText: Files are not synced yet: copying a file in the file manager is ignored for now. Text, links and images work. Devices must be able to reach each other on TCP 45456; UDP 45457 is only discovery, so a network that blocks broadcast needs the other device's address.
home.whatText: ClipboardSync keeps one clipboard board across the devices you pair. Copy text, a link or an image on one machine and it shows up on the others, ready to paste. Every device talks directly to the others over an encrypted session; there is no account and no server in the middle.

features.name: One shared board
features.text: Every paired device shows the same history, grouped by the device an item came from.

features.name: Text and links
features.text: Copying text or a URL sends it to the other devices and applies it to their clipboard.

features.name: Images
features.text: Image copies are sent as PNG, previewed on the board and applied automatically. The size limit is yours to set.

features.name: Direct connections
features.text: Devices find each other on the local network and talk over TCP. Nothing is relayed through a third party.

features.name: Encrypted sessions
features.text: An Ed25519 identity, fresh X25519 keys and ChaCha20-Poly1305 protect every frame.

features.name: Pairing code
features.text: Both screens derive the same short code from the handshake, so you can compare them before trusting a device.

features.name: Discovery and manual address
features.text: UDP discovery finds devices on the same network; an address field covers networks where broadcast is blocked.

features.name: Tray and autostart
features.text: Close to the tray, start hidden, launch at sign-in and keep a single instance.

how: Install ClipboardSync on two devices that can reach each other on the same network.
Pair them: pick a discovered device or enter its address, then compare the code shown on both screens.
Copy anything. The item lands on both boards and is applied to the other clipboard; a periodic reconciliation fills in whatever a device missed.
